title: knowledge_acquisition.stage.dead_lettered payload (v1)
description: Payload of the knowledge_acquisition.stage.dead_lettered outbox event. Producer: app/knowledge_acquisition/stage_events.py::emit_stage_dead_letter (stage, stage_version, content_identity, reason, error, optional extractor_id). Consumer (KA-07, #3107): app/workers/outbox_worker.py::handle_knowledge_acquisition_stage_dead_lettered -- surfaces a durable, item-scoped observability signal and never raises, so one item's dead-letter never blocks a sibling item's dispatch.
